purpose: Use available historical data immediately to reject weak hypotheses without converting survivorship-biased diagnostics into live-trading evidence.

feature_availability_contract.decision_feature_rule: A historical decision feature requires both an event timestamp and evidence that it was available no later than the decision timestamp.

allowed_uses: postmortem explanation for already sealed failed trials

lanes.role: Immediate historical development, stress, and rejection work on a fixed preregistered universe.
prohibited: treating a surviving-symbol result as point-in-time OOS evidence

lanes.role: Historical OOS is eligible for research comparison only when each decision-day membership is proven by a contemporaneously timestamped source.
The surviving candidate must be tested using only data collected after its immutable preregistration and prior-day point-in-time membership snapshots.
